ret: 4 training days (press, dead, bench and squat) holding 8 exercises, over block weeks train ×3, deload, repeating.
Block weeks: train, train, train, deload, repeating. If you miss a session the plan waits: the next session is still the one you missed. Loads on a 5 lb grid.
Rotation: Each training week: Day press, then Day dead, then Day bench, then Day squat.
Attendance (from the rotation): Train at least 4 times in each 7-day window (from your start day). If you don't train for 21 days, attendance stops counting until your next session.

press: Wendler 5/3/1 on Overhead Press: three waves off a training max that starts at 90% of your estimated max, AMRAP last set, deload week; after each cycle's deload add 5 lb, or propose a reset to 90% of TM if any AMRAP fell short.

dead: Wendler 5/3/1 on Deadlift: three waves off a training max that starts at 90% of your estimated max, AMRAP last set, deload week; after each cycle's deload add 10 lb, or propose a reset to 90% of TM if any AMRAP fell short.

bench: Wendler 5/3/1 on Barbell Bench Press: three waves off a training max that starts at 90% of your estimated max, AMRAP last set, deload week; after each cycle's deload add 5 lb, or propose a reset to 90% of TM if any AMRAP fell short.

squat: Wendler 5/3/1 on Barbell Back Squat: three waves off a training max that starts at 90% of your estimated max, AMRAP last set, deload week; after each cycle's deload add 10 lb, or propose a reset to 90% of TM if any AMRAP fell short.
pressBbb: Boring But Big: 5×10 on Overhead Press at 50% of the press slot's training max; three sets in deload weeks.
deadBbb: Boring But Big: 5×10 on Deadlift at 50% of the dead slot's training max; three sets in deload weeks.
benchBbb: Boring But Big: 5×10 on Barbell Bench Press at 50% of the bench slot's training max; three sets in deload weeks.
squatBbb: Boring But Big: 5×10 on Barbell Back Squat at 50% of the squat slot's training max; three sets in deload weeks.

Wendler 5/3/1 on Overhead Press: three waves off a training max that starts at 90% of your estimated max, AMRAP last set, deload week; after each cycle's deload add 5 lb, or propose a reset to 90% of TM if any AMRAP fell short
Reads your estimated max (kept on file; ignored once older than 56 days).
Starts with training max = 90% of your estimated max for Overhead Press; written by cycleEnd, owner.
Starts with “an AMRAP fell short this cycle” = no; written by session, cycleEnd.

Plan:
    - if this is a deload week: Overhead Press: 1 set of 5 reps at 40% of your training max; 1 set of 5 reps at 50% of your training max; 1 set of 5 reps at 60% of your training max.
    - otherwise: Overhead Press: 1 set of 5/3/5 reps at 65/70/75% of your training max; 1 set of 5/3/3 reps at 75/80/85% of your training max; 1 set of as many reps as possible (at least 5/3/1 reps) at 85/90/95% of your training max (slashed values step by training week, repeating).
After each session: Note whether an AMRAP fell short this cycle: an AMRAP fell short this cycle or the reps you logged on “s3” is below the reps prescribed for “s3” (no if unknown).

After each cycle (after its deload week):
    - if an AMRAP fell short this cycle: Reset the note that an AMRAP fell short this cycle; and propose, for your OK: set training max to 90% of your training max.
    - otherwise: Set training max to your training max plus 5 lb.
